numAllowedMissingIngredientsTooltip: Should random extra ingredients be added on meal creation? Useful if you have little ingredient variety. If greater than 0, 1 extra ingredient will be added, and more may be added until the total number of meal ingredients equals or exceeds the cap. Extra ingredients will match the meal's recipe and diet (carnivore, vegetarian, etc).
quickSearchTooltip: True: The search will stop after 10 candidate names for the meal are found: less varied results\nFalse: The search will find all candidate names: more varied results
flavorTextForStacks: Show Flavor Text on Meal Stacks
flavorTextForStacksTooltip: Enabled: Stacks of meals will be named.\n\nDisabled, stacks of meals will have their original name.
laxRecipeMatchingTooltip: Labels for modded meals will still appear on the normal vanilla meals. E.g. if modded soups are present, "egg drop soup" can still appear as the name for a vanilla simple meal.\n\nWILL TAKE EFFECT ON GAME RESTART
dynamicMealIncorporationTooltip: Flavor Text will attempt to find additional meal types that should receive names, outside of those vanilla and modded ones explicitly defined. May pick up inappropriate meals.\n\nWILL TAKE EFFECT ON GAME RESTART
